about.title: Preserving Timeless Vedic Heritage & Upholding Social Harmony
about.desc1: Rashtriya Sanatan Sanskar Seva Sansthan (Trust) was established with a sacred pledge: to counter the cultural alienation and moral erosion weakening Sanatan families under unstructured westernization, while building a resilient, self-reliant, and united community.
about.desc2: Our foundation bridges timeless spiritual values with tangible humanitarian service. Through widespread awareness of the 16 Vedic Sanskars, scriptural education, community temple hubs, and direct labor welfare outreach, we empower every segment of society.
about.missionDesc: To place national interest and Sanatan values paramount, conducting multi-faceted initiatives that make families self-reliant, eradicate ostentatious expenditure, and restore cultural pride.
about.visionDesc: A harmonious society where the 16 Vedic Sanskars are practiced accessible to all regardless of economic status, strengthening joint families and nurturing future generations with timeless character.
about.leadershipQuote: "Our aim is to empower the economically vulnerable, awaken spiritual discipline, and unite every Sanatani on a common platform for nation and dharma. With your dedication of time, mind, and resources, this noble mission touches every home."

socialVision.title: Our Vision: Comprehensive Social Reformation & Cultural Revival
socialVision.subtitle: Building a self-reliant, ethical, and united society free from social ostentation, debt traps, substance abuse, and neglect of elders.
socialVision.quote: "Dharma is not confined to private prayer—it is a living commitment to social justice, domestic simplicity, mutual enterprise, and uplifting every underprivileged brother and sister."
socialVision.pillarsSubtitle: Through these 8 dedicated pillars, our Trust drives tangible, positive transformation into the everyday lives of families and communities:

pillars.title: Eradication of Ostentation & Debt Traps
pillars.desc: Stopping lavish societal show-offs, dowry pressure, and unmanageable expenses in weddings and rites. Protecting middle-class and daily-wage families from usurious loans by championing dignified, low-cost Vedic ceremonies as the true hallmark of prestige.

pillars.title: Revival of Joint Families & Dignity for Elders
pillars.desc: Revitalizing the traditional joint family structure through weekly dialogue, filial respect, and intergenerational bonding. Creating a society with such deep family warmth that old-age homes and orphanages become unnecessary.

pillars.title: Substance De-Addiction & Youth Empowerment
pillars.desc: Active ground campaigns against alcoholism, gutkha, and tobacco. Preventing premature deaths among youth by channeling their vitality into Yoga, physical fitness, scriptural study, and national service.

pillars.title: Hereditary Trades & Economic Self-Reliance
pillars.desc: Supporting traditional crafts, indigenous occupations, and small cottage businesses. Encouraging community mutual commerce so that youth become proud micro-entrepreneurs rather than migrating in distress.

pillars.title: Temple-Centric Community Empowerment
pillars.desc: Transforming neighborhood and village temples beyond prayer into active hubs for weekly civic assemblies, health counseling, educational classes, and community problem-solving.

pillars.title: Women's Honor, Kanya Pujan & Marriage Aid
pillars.desc: Ensuring utmost reverence for daughters and mothers. Celebrating sacred Kanya Pujan on festivals while extending financial and logistical support for the dignified weddings of daughters from underprivileged families.

pillars.title: Unorganized Labor Welfare & Social Justice
pillars.desc: Enrolling construction workers, cart vendors, and daily wagers into government social security (e-Shram, PM-SYM pensions, educational scholarships, maternity aid) through dedicated on-ground camps.

pillars.title: Culture of Tithe (Dashansh) for Public Welfare
pillars.desc: Promoting the Vedic principle of Dashansh (dedicating 10% of earnings, skills, or time to societal good). Channeling voluntary donations transparently into medical aid, emergency relief, cow protection, and student support.

manifestoCallout.title: Our Guiding Maxim: Nation First, Sanatan Values, Family Harmony
manifestoCallout.desc: When the family is strong, society becomes resilient; when society is united, the nation regains its preeminent cultural leadership. Social reformation is our pathway to collective prosperity and universal peace.

sanskars.title: The 16 Sacred Sanskars (षोडश संस्कार)
sanskars.subtitle: According to Sanatan scriptures, 16 sacred Sanskars are performed to purify, refine, and elevate human life from before birth through liberation.
sanskars.benefitDesc: Adhering to the 16 Sanskars brings spiritual peace, prosperity to the family, emotional bonding among members, and societal virtue.
sanskars.ctaText: Would you like to organize any of the 16 Sanskars or sacred Pujas at minimal cost? Contact the Sansthan.

items.name: Garbhadhan Sanskar
items.desc: Conception ceremony performed with sacred intent and auspicious timing for healthy, morally elevated progeny.

items.name: Punsavan Sanskar
items.desc: Performed after the 3rd month of pregnancy for fetal safety, physical health, and wholesome growth.

items.name: Seemantonnayan Sanskar
items.desc: Performed between the 6th and 8th month for maternal mental serenity and fetal neurological/intellectual well-being.

items.name: Jatkarma Sanskar
items.desc: Performed immediately upon childbirth; newborn is fed a touch of honey and ghee with prayers for longevity.

items.name: Namkaran Sanskar
items.desc: Naming ceremony conducted on the 10th to 12th day after birth according to Vedic astrological calculations.

items.name: Nishkraman Sanskar
items.desc: Carried out in the 3rd to 4th month when the infant is first brought outdoors into gentle sunlight and fresh air.

items.name: Annaprashan Sanskar
items.desc: First solid food offering to the infant in the 6th month, praying for health, vitality, and purity of senses.

items.name: Chudakarma / Mundan Sanskar
items.desc: First tonsure of head hair between the ages of 1 and 3 for purification, mental sharpness, and health.

items.name: Karnavedha Sanskar
items.desc: Ear piercing performed between ages 3 and 5 for holistic health, acupuncture benefits, and aesthetic grace.

items.name: Vidyarambha Sanskar
items.desc: Initiation into literacy and basic learning around age 5 with Saraswati Vandana and auspicious writing.

items.name: Upanayana / Yajnopaveet Sanskar
items.desc: Sacred thread investiture ceremony between ages 8 and 12, marking initiation into discipline and Brahmacharya.

items.name: Vedarambha Sanskar
items.desc: Commencement of formal study of Vedas, Upanishads, and sacred scriptures under an enlightened Guru.

items.name: Keshanta Sanskar
items.desc: First shaving of beard and hair upon completion of Brahmacharya phase with Guru Dakshina.

items.name: Samavartana Sanskar
items.desc: Convocation ceremony marking successful completion of education and transition into societal responsibility.

items.name: Vivaha Sanskar
items.desc: Holy matrimonial vows entering the Grihastha Ashram, celebrated as the most foundational social sacrament.

items.name: Antyeshti Sanskar
items.desc: Final rites and sacred cremation for spiritual liberation and peace of the departing soul.

guidelines.title: 12 Core Principles for Sanatan Families
guidelines.subtitle: Drawn directly from our founding manifesto to build self-reliant, debt-free, and morally upright households.

items.title: Avoid Ostentation
items.desc: Strive to avoid all forms of show-off, lavish display, and financial extravagance in domestic and community events.

items.title: Sanatan Attire & Dignity
items.desc: Embrace decent, traditional Sanatan and modest full attire for yourself and family members with cultural pride.

items.title: Mutual Community Brotherhood
items.desc: Prioritize mutual exchange of services, daily commerce, and supportive closeness within the Sanatan community.

items.title: Preserve Ancestral Occupations
items.desc: Alongside public/private employment, revive and preserve traditional ancestral trades to foster economic self-reliance.

items.title: Debt-Free Living
items.desc: Perform social and family obligations strictly within economic capacity to prevent harmful debt traps.

items.title: Plant a Tree on Celebrations
items.desc: Celebrate auspicious family milestones by planting at least one tree and presenting useful gifts to those in need.

items.title: Weekly Temple Gathering
items.desc: Organize weekly community gatherings at local neighborhood/village temples to strengthen neighborhood unity.

items.title: Temples as Community & Spiritual Centers
items.desc: Ensure every ward/village has an active temple and develop temple premises into vibrant spiritual and skill-sharing centers.

items.title: De-addiction & Screen Discipline
items.desc: Abstain strictly from intoxicants, narcotics, and tobacco; regulate excessive smartphone and screen addiction.

items.title: Nurture Joint Family Harmony
items.desc: Uphold joint family values with weekly family gatherings, meals, or video conferences to keep emotional bonds unbreakable.

items.title: Conduct Events in Auspicious Muhurat
items.desc: Perform ceremonies on auspicious dates (Shubh Tithi/Muhurat) for spiritual benefits, and assist underprivileged families.

items.title: Donate Dashansh (One-Tenth)
items.desc: As prescribed in ancient scriptures, dedicate one-tenth (Dashansh) of earnings towards societal welfare, dharma, and family upliftment.

objectives.motto: National Welfare ! Sanatan Welfare !! Family Welfare !!!
objectives.title: Our Objectives — 16 Founding Pillars
objectives.subtitle: The 16 core institutional objectives guiding our national mission for Vedic heritage, grassroots self-reliance, and family welfare:
objectives.letterBody: In light of the adverse cultural impact of modern consumerism affecting Sanatan families and societal bonds, Rashtriya Sanatan Sanskar Seva Sansthan (Trust) was established to awaken awareness of the 16 Vedic Sanskars and facilitate their practice at minimal expense. Our mission is to make the Sanatan community self-reliant, morally strong, and to restore Bharat's pride. Operated with the suggestions and active cooperation of the community, this nationalist multipurpose institution strives to unite families and build a dignified society. We invite your wholehearted cooperation with body, mind, and resources. Vande Mataram.

items.title: National & Sanatan Interest Paramount
items.desc: Working multipurpose welfare initiatives while keeping national integrity and Sanatan cultural resurgence paramount.

items.title: 16 Vedic Sanskars at Minimal Expense
items.desc: Spreading wide awareness of the 16 Vedic life rites and providing hands-on facilitation to conduct them with dignity at low cost.

items.title: Education, Health, Security & Livelihood
items.desc: Extending steadfast support to all community members in quality education, healthcare, protection, self-employment, and social security.

items.title: Study & Teaching of Sacred Scriptures
items.desc: Encouraging regular study and recitation of Ramcharitmanas, Bhagavad Gita, Vedas, Puranas, and Upanishads in homes and schools.

items.title: Temples as Vibrant Community Hubs
items.desc: Developing local temples in every village and neighborhood into vibrant spiritual, cultural, and community assembly hubs.

items.title: Rights of Laborers & Scheme Workers
items.desc: Advocating for the rights, dignity, and entitlements of organized, unorganized, contractual, and grassroots scheme workers.

items.title: Facilitating Government Welfare Schemes
items.desc: Disseminating Central and State welfare programs, grants, and subsidies to ensure benefits reach eligible grassroots families.

items.title: Celebration of Sanatan Festivals
items.desc: Educating families on the sacred significance of Hindu festivals and assisting in their grand, united community celebrations.

items.title: Folk Songs Archive & Cultural Competitions
items.desc: Compiling authentic traditional devotional hymns, preserving cultural folklore, and hosting youth talent competitions.

items.title: Vigilance, Awareness & Administrative Aid
items.desc: Empowering communities through legal and administrative coordination against threats, radicalization, and exploitation.

items.title: Joint Family Harmony & Zero Old-Age Homes
items.desc: Fostering mutual affection, family dialogue, and joint-family bonds to eliminate the need for old-age homes and orphanages.

items.title: Freedom from Debt & Extravagance
items.desc: Promoting simplicity and discouraging wasteful competitive ostentation so families remain completely free of debt traps.

items.title: De-Addiction & Health Preservation
items.desc: Conducting mass anti-tobacco and de-addiction campaigns to safeguard physical health, vitality, and prevent untimely deaths.

items.title: Unified Sanatan Platform for Nation Pride
items.desc: Striving to bring all Sanatan followers together onto a shared national platform to restore Bharat's historic pride.

items.title: Matrimonial Support for Underprivileged
items.desc: Providing practical support and community sponsorship for the dignified wedding ceremonies of underprivileged youths.

items.title: Holistic Upliftment of Marginalized
items.desc: Ensuring sustainable assistance in education, healthcare, safety, and entrepreneurship for marginalized citizens.
